mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reflects a tighter monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and employment (PAYEMS) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS decline from their previous month's value.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (a contraction threshold) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 (thousands of units) signals weak consumer demand for housing, which reduces construction sector activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of very low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), the labor market is tight, leading to wage pressures and potential inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 380,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending, which reduces corporate revenue and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS falls below 380000.
